method: Read all captured model wire replies, immutable fixture source, baseline, merged result and verification sidecar. Judgments below are explicit source adjudications; no keyword classifier was used. Runtime code and automatic scores were not changed.
scope: Two completed deployment_v2.1 Hive suites: 10 core cases plus 5 holdout cases, each repeated 3 times. The constructed unrelated-evidence case is excluded from live model metrics.
limitations: This is an independent agent source review, not a blinded external human audit.
No application, npm ci, Docker build or cloud deployment was executed during this manual review.
Repeated runs on small synthetic fixtures do not estimate accuracy on arbitrary repositories.
Supported means bounded source support, not runtime success or production readiness.
A deferred incorrect proposal is still an incorrect model proposal, even when the rejected-only counter is zero.
Correct model advisories outside implemented verifier rules are not automatically trusted execution inputs.
Relative artifact links refer to locally retained ignored artifacts; report publication does not publish raw artifacts.
